# OLD-UI-PARITY P1 — Top-Bar Chips Plan

**Plan only — no implementation in this artifact.**

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Repo | `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof` |
| Base | `master` @ `8a40ab7` (PR #72 panel manager merged) |
| Version | `2.1.34` |
| Scope | Smallest safe slice to restore old top-bar discoverability for Mission / Ecosystem / Tasks / Alerts / Command Palette |
| Out of scope | OperatorNav redesign, AdaptiveLayoutEngine, Search/Graph/Profile/Community, new modules, `package:product`, version bump, tag |

---

## Post-merge validation (2026-05-19)

| Step | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build --prefix src/renderer` | Pass |
| `npm run lint` | Pass |
| `npm test` | Pass |
| `node tear/p0-panel-manager-proof.js` | Pass (`p0-panel-manager-proof: OK`) |

P0 panel manager is verified on this tree; recovery rail buttons are wired to real drawers. P1 can proceed once this plan is reviewed.

---

## 1. Current `TopStatusBar.jsx` inventory

**File:** `src/renderer/src/components/TopStatusBar.jsx`

### Always-visible right cluster (today)

| UI element | `data-testid` | Handler prop | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model select | — | `setModel` | Local model picker |
| Presence pill | `presence-pill` | — | Provider/latency telemetry |
| Watchdog badge | `watchdog-status-badge` | `onOpenRuntimeAlerts` | Opens `RuntimeAlertsDrawer` |
| EXEC button | `command-palette-btn` | `onOpenPalette` | Opens command palette |
| More menu toggle | `more-menu-btn` | local `setMoreOpen` | Dropdown for secondary panels |
| Theme / Settings | `theme-toggle-btn`, `settings-open-btn` | `setTheme`, `onOpenSettings` | UI prefs / settings drawer |
| Mode badges | various | appliance/airgap/demo handlers | Conditional GTM badges |

### Hidden behind **More** dropdown (only rendered when `moreOpen === true`)

| Label | `data-testid` | Handler prop | Section |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Analytics | `analytics-open-btn` | `onOpenAnalytics` | infrastructure |
| **Ecosystem** | `ecosystem-open-btn` | `onOpenEcosystem` | infrastructure |
| **Mission Control** | `mission-control-open-btn` | `onOpenMissionControl` | infrastructure |
| Fleet Control | `fleet-control-open-btn` | `onOpenFleetControl` | infrastructure |
| Institutional | `institutional-command-open-btn` | `onOpenInstitutionalCommand` | infrastructure |
| Demo Flow / Field Launch | `demo-flow-open-btn`, `field-launch-open-btn` | GTM-only | launch |
| **Task Manager** | `task-manager-open-btn` | `onOpenTaskManager` | tools |
| Scratchpad | `scratchpad-open-btn` | `onToggleScratchpad` | tools |
| Feedback | `feedback-btn` | feedback handler | tools |

**Discoverability gap:** Mission, Ecosystem, and Task Manager require two clicks (More → item). Playwright specs target `mission-control-open-btn` / `ecosystem-open-btn` directly; those nodes are **not in the DOM** until More is open — promoting chips fixes E2E alignment as well as operator UX.

### Not in scope for P1 chips

- Search, Graph, Profile, Community (explicitly deferred)
- Fleet, Institutional, Analytics, Scratchpad (remain More-only for this slice)
- Full legacy `renderer.html` header (`Palette`, `Support`, `Health` buttons) — reference only

---

## 2. Existing handlers and state (`App.jsx`)

All target panels are already mounted and toggled in `App.jsx`. `TopStatusBar` receives callbacks only; no new state is required for P1.

| Concern | State | Opener (TopStatusBar prop) | Panel component |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Command Palette | `showPalette` via `useShell()` | `onOpenPalette` → `openPalette` | `CommandPalette` |
| Mission Control | `showMissionControl` | `onOpenMissionControl` → `setShowMissionControl(true)` | `MissionControl.jsx` |
| Ecosystem Launcher | `showEcosystem` | `onOpenEcosystem` → `setShowEcosystem(true)` | `EcosystemLauncher.jsx` |
| Task Manager | `showTaskManager` | `onOpenTaskManager` → `setShowTaskManager(true)` | `TaskManagerDrawer.jsx` |
| Runtime Alerts | `showRuntimeAlerts` | `onOpenRuntimeAlerts` → `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` | `RuntimeAlertsDrawer.jsx` |

**Wiring reference** (`App.jsx` ~2837–2877):

```jsx
onOpenPalette={openPalette}
onOpenEcosystem={() => setShowEcosystem(true)}
onOpenMissionControl={() => setShowMissionControl(true)}
onOpenRuntimeAlerts={() => setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)}
onOpenTaskManager={() => setShowTaskManager(true)}
```

**Alternate entry points (unchanged by P1):**

| Route | Mechanism |
| --- | --- |
| Slash | `/mission`, `/ecosystem`, `/tasks` (and aliases `/taskmanager`, `/processes`) in `App.jsx` chat command handler |
| Runtime panel router | `openRuntimePanelById('mission-control' \| 'watchdog' \| 'task-manager')` |
| Tray / main menu | `tray:open-palette`, `tray:open-task-manager` (`src/main.js`) |
| Keyboard | Ctrl+K palette (documented in palette help); Ctrl+Shift+T task manager (main process) |
| Watchdog | `WatchdogStatusBadge` click → same as `onOpenRuntimeAlerts` |
| Ecosystem → Mission | `EcosystemLauncher` internal “Open Mission Control” button |

---

## 3. Modules reachable today (More / slash / palette)

| Module | Exists | Top bar (P1 target) | More menu | Slash | Palette registry |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mission Control | Yes (`MissionControl.jsx`, `data-testid="mission-control"`) | Hidden | Yes | `/mission` | Via slash help text |
| Ecosystem Launcher | Yes (`EcosystemLauncher.jsx`) | Hidden | Yes | `/ecosystem` | Via slash help text |
| Task Manager | Yes (`TaskManagerDrawer.jsx`) | Hidden | Yes | `/tasks` | — |
| Runtime Alerts | Yes (`RuntimeAlertsDrawer.jsx`, `runtime-alerts-drawer`) | **Watchdog badge** (visible) | No | `/watchdog` path via `openRuntimePanelById` | — |
| Command Palette | Yes (`CommandPalette.jsx`) | **EXEC** (visible) | No | — | `moduleRegistry` `palette.commands` / `palette.system` |

**Registry note:** Core palette commands live in `src/renderer/src/state/moduleRegistry.js`. P1 does not add registry entries — chips call existing `App.jsx` callbacks only.

---

## 4. Proposed P1 chips (smallest safe slice)

### Add three compact chips (new visible controls)

Place in the right cluster **after** `presence-pill` and **before** `WatchdogStatusBadge`, using the same compact chip style as EXEC (rounded border, `text-[11px]`, mono).

| Chip label | `data-testid` (keep existing IDs) | Handler | Opens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Mission** | `mission-control-open-btn` | `onOpenMissionControl` | Mission Control cockpit |
| **Eco** or **Ecosystem** | `ecosystem-open-btn` | `onOpenEcosystem` | Ecosystem Launcher |
| **Tasks** | `task-manager-open-btn` | `onOpenTaskManager` | Task Manager drawer |

**Responsive guard (required):** wrap chip group in `hidden lg:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5` (match `CollabStatusPill` pattern) so sub-`lg` widths keep a single header row per `SHELL_CONTRACT.md` / `ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md` rule 1.

**Optional polish (zero new handlers):**

- EXEC `title`: `Command Palette (Ctrl+K)` (discoverability; label stays `EXEC`)
- Watchdog `title`: mention “Runtime Alerts” explicitly (already opens drawer)

### Do not add in P1

| Item | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| Separate **Alerts** chip | Duplicates `watchdog-status-badge` → `onOpenRuntimeAlerts` (rule 6: no duplicated actions) |
| Separate **Palette** chip | Duplicates `command-palette-btn` / EXEC |
| Search / Graph / Profile / Community | Explicitly out of slice |
| Fleet / Institutional / Analytics chips | Not in old-UI P1 parity ask; remain in More |

### More menu policy (implementation choice)

- **Recommended:** Keep Mission / Ecosystem / Task entries in More for one release (transitional parity); document duplication justification: “restore one-click discoverability without removing fallback path.”
- **Optional follow-up:** Remove the three duplicates from More once chips ship and soak.

---

## 5. Source files involved

| File | P1 change |
| --- | --- |
| `src/renderer/src/components/TopStatusBar.jsx` | **Only required file** — add visible chip group; reuse existing props |
| `src/renderer/src/App.jsx` | **No change** — handlers already passed |
| `MissionControl.jsx`, `EcosystemLauncher.jsx`, `TaskManagerDrawer.jsx`, `RuntimeAlertsDrawer.jsx`, `CommandPalette.jsx` | No change |
| `e2e/*.spec.js` | No change if test IDs preserved on visible chips |
| `tear/architecture-enforcement.test.js` | No change (required hooks unchanged) |

---

## 6. Risk level

**Overall: Low** (UI-only, existing callbacks, no IPC/state/schema changes)

| Risk | Mitigation |
| --- | --- |
| Header horizontal overflow | `hidden lg:` chip group; short labels (`Mission`, `Eco`, `Tasks`) |
| Perceived duplicate actions in More | Transitional; note in release notes |
| Contract “no header clutter” | Stay one row; no second row; max +3 compact chips within breakpoint |
| Accidental scope creep | No new props, modules, or `openRuntimePanelById` changes |

---

## 7. Acceptance checks

### Build / static

- [ ] `npm run build --prefix src/renderer`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `node tear/p0-panel-manager-proof.js` (regression guard)

### Manual (desktop, ≥1280px width)

- [ ] **Mission** chip visible without opening More; click → `mission-control` visible; close works
- [ ] **Ecosystem** chip visible; click → ecosystem launcher visible
- [ ] **Tasks** chip visible; click → task manager drawer visible
- [ ] **Watchdog** badge still opens `runtime-alerts-drawer` (no regression)
- [ ] **EXEC** still opens command palette
- [ ] Below `lg` breakpoint: chips hidden; More menu still opens all three panels

### Automated (existing suites — no spec edits if test IDs move to visible chips)

- [ ] `e2e/missionControl.spec.js` — `mission-control-open-btn` clickable without More
- [ ] `e2e/ecosystemLauncher.spec.js` — `ecosystem-open-btn`
- [ ] `e2e/watchdogAlerts.spec.js` — `watchdog-status-badge`
- [ ] `e2e/react-core.spec.js` — `command-palette-btn`

### Non-goals verification

- [ ] No version bump, tag, or `package:product`
- [ ] No AdaptiveLayoutEngine / OperatorNav changes
- [ ] No new files under `src/renderer/src/components/` except plan artifact

---

## 8. Implementation surface: one file vs `App.jsx`

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Should P1 be implemented in `TopStatusBar.jsx` only? | **Yes** |
| Does `App.jsx` need changes? | **No** — all five handlers already wired at `TopStatusBar` invocation |
| New props? | **No** |
| New modules? | **No** |

**Suggested implementation sketch (TopStatusBar only):**

1. Extract a small inline `TopBarChip({ label, testId, onClick, className })` *or* duplicate 3 button blocks (prefer inline duplication per project minimal-diff norm).
2. Render chip group when `typeof onOpenMissionControl === 'function'` (etc.), matching More menu’s guard pattern.
3. Preserve exact `data-testid` values listed above.
4. Do not alter EXEC or Watchdog components beyond optional `title` strings.

---

## 9. Summary

| Proposed chips | Handlers | `App.jsx`? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mission, Ecosystem, Tasks (visible @ lg+) | Existing props | Not required |
| Alerts | Existing Watchdog badge | Not required |
| Command Palette | Existing EXEC button | Not required |

**Next step after plan approval:** implement P1 in `TopStatusBar.jsx` only, run acceptance checks, then open PR scoped to old-UI parity P1 (no version/release automation).

Many Playwright specs click `mission-control-open-btn` / `ecosystem-open-btn` directly, but those nodes only exist when More is open. Promoting chips to the always-visible bar fixes that gap without changing test IDs.

# Lazy-Boundary / AdaptiveLayoutEngine Inventory

**Read-only inventory — no implementation in this artifact.**

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Repo | `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Archives\NeuralShell_release_master_proof` |
| Base | `master` @ `390874c` (P0 #72, P1 #74 merged) |
| May 2 reference | `C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell\validation-artifacts\ui-recovery\asar-full-release-232\src\renderer\` |
| Current renderer | `src/renderer/` |
| Date | 2026-05-19 |

---

## Executive summary

May 2 shipped a **chunked packaged renderer**: `App.jsx` alone declares **~136 `React.lazy` boundaries**, and the built `dist-renderer/js/` tree contains **163 async chunks** (e.g. `MissionControl-*.js`, `EcosystemLauncher-*.js`, `AdaptiveLayoutEngine-*.js`, `TaskManagerDrawer-*.js`). Entry `index-CDfqmjqJ.js` ≈ **660 KB**.

Current `master` recovered most **source** and improved **discoverability** (P0 panel manager, P1 top-bar chips), but `App.jsx` has **zero `React.lazy` imports**. Roughly **60 operator/GTM modules** are **eager static imports**, producing a single main bundle (`index-*.js` ≈ **857 KB** in local builds) plus only a handful of incidental chunks (`VoicePanel`, `ScratchpadTab`, `OnboardingProgressRail`, vendors).

The largest architectural gaps vs May 2:

1. **No lazy boundaries in `App.jsx`** (bundle shape regression).
2. **`OperationsCoreLayer` exists but is not mounted**; Mission/Ecosystem/Task are wired via **parallel `useState` + eager JSX** instead of `panels.open('mission-control'|'ecosystem')`.
3. **`AdaptiveLayoutEngine` source exists but is not imported or mounted**; partial rail-preset constants remain in `App.jsx` without `handleAdaptiveLayout` / `neuralshell:apply-layout` dispatch.

**Recommended order:** restore **lazy import boundaries first** (especially operator consoles), then **mount ALE**, then consider **OperationsCoreLayer** only after panel-id unification — **not** before ALE, and **not** as a substitute for P1 top-bar chips.

---

## 1. May 2 lazy-boundary map (`App.jsx`)

### Shell structure (May 2)

| Layer | Import style | Mount |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TopStatusBar` | Eager | Always |
| `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` | Eager | Main workspace |
| `OperationsCoreLayer` | **Eager shell**, lazy children | Always mounted |
| `PaletteAndSettingsLayer` | Eager wrapper | Lazy `CommandPalette`, `SettingsDrawer` |
| `LayoutControlBar` | Eager | Lazy `OnboardingProgressRail` |
| `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` | **`React.lazy` in App** | `panels.isOpen('adaptive-layout')` |
| Operator drawers (long tail) | **`React.lazy` in App** | `panels.isOpen('<id>')` |

### May 2 `App.jsx` — priority modules (user list)

| Component | Lazy in App? | Mounted via | Reachability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **AdaptiveLayoutEngine** | Yes | `panels.isOpen('adaptive-layout')` | Workbench/slash; `onApplyLayout={handleAdaptiveLayout}` |
| **OperationsCoreLayer** | No (eager) | Always | Hosts lazy Analytics / Ecosystem / Mission / Fleet / Recovery |
| **MissionControl** | No in App; **yes inside OCL** | `panels.isOpen('mission-control')` via OCL | Top bar, ecosystem, slash `/mission`, tray |
| **EcosystemLauncher** | No in App; **yes inside OCL** | `panels.isOpen('ecosystem')` via OCL | Top bar, slash `/ecosystem` |
| **TaskManagerDrawer** | Yes | `panels.isOpen('task-manager')` | Top bar, slash, tray, hotkey |
| **RuntimeAlertsDrawer** | Yes | `panels.isOpen('runtime-alerts')` | Watchdog badge, slash |
| **VoiceMode** | Yes | `panels.isOpen('voice-mode')` | Workbench |

| **ScratchpadTab** | Lazy in `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` | Scratchpad route / panel | Workspace |

| **CommandPalette** | Lazy in `PaletteAndSettingsLayer` | `showPalette` | EXEC / Ctrl+K |

### Current bundle shape (post PR #73 vite config)

- `vite.config.js`: `manualChunks` splits **only `node_modules`** (vendor-react, vendor-motion, etc.).
- Application code: effectively **one fat `index-*.js`** unless a file uses `import()` / `React.lazy`.
- Local build observation (pre-merge clean tree): ~**857 KB** `index-*.js` vs May 2 **660 KB** entry + **163** feature chunks.
- `dist-renderer/js` may be absent after `git restore`; rebuild reproduces the monolith pattern.

---

## 3. Missing boundary table (May 2 → current)

| Component / concern | May 2 | Current | Classification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| App-level `React.lazy` count | ~136 | **0** | **Missing boundaries** |
| MissionControl chunk | Lazy (OCL) | Eager in main bundle | **Eager and mounted** |
| EcosystemLauncher chunk | Lazy (OCL) | Eager in main bundle | **Eager and mounted** |
| TaskManagerDrawer chunk | Lazy | Eager in main bundle | **Eager and mounted** |
| RuntimeAlertsDrawer chunk | Lazy | Eager in main bundle | **Eager and mounted** |
| CommandPalette / Settings | Lazy (palette layer) | Eager in App | **Eager and mounted** |
| OperationsCoreLayer | Eager mount + lazy ops | Source only | **Lazy children exist; layer not mounted** |
| AdaptiveLayoutEngine | Lazy + mounted | Source only | **Source exists; not imported** |
| Panel manager for mission/ecosystem | `panels.open(...)` | `useState` booleans | **Dual control plane** |
| ProvGraph | Eager | Not imported | **Source exists; not imported** |
| Voice | `VoiceMode` lazy | `VoicePanel` lazy in recovery layer | **Different component; recovery reachable** |
| Knowledge / AI Memory (full UI) | Eager/lazy mix | Placeholders in recovery layer | **Hidden / placeholder in recovery** |
| WorkspacePanel sub-widgets (Proof, KB, etc.) | Many lazy in May 2 `WorkspacePanel` | Current `WorkspacePanel` has **no** lazy | **Legacy path only** (`USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL=false`) |

---

## 4. AdaptiveLayoutEngine — deep dive

### Source

- **Exists:** `src/renderer/src/components/AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx`
- **Exports:** default UI + `recordLayoutAction(action)` for usage telemetry
- **Storage:** `neuralshell_adaptive_layout_v1`, dispatches `neuralshell:layout-chrome-updated`

### May 2 role

- Modal panel: presets (minimal, operator, writing, coding, …), per-panel visibility flags, rail width hints
- Opened via `panels.open('adaptive-layout')`
- **`handleAdaptiveLayout`** in App:
  - Calls `synchronizeAppLayoutFromAdaptiveEngine(layout)`
  - Maps preset id → rail preset via `ADAPTIVE_LAYOUT_TO_RAIL_PRESET`
  - Dispatches `neuralshell:apply-layout` with public layout payload
  - Appends kernel chat confirmation

### Current state

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Imported in App? | **No** |
| Mounted? | **No** |
| `handleAdaptiveLayout`? | **Missing** (only `ADAPTIVE_LAYOUT_TO_RAIL_PRESET` constant remains) |
| `synchronizeAppLayoutFromAdaptiveEngine`? | **Missing** in current App |
| Consumer of layout events? | `useAdaptiveLayoutChrome` in **`MultiWorkspace.jsx`** listens for `neuralshell:apply-layout` |
| Recovery shell uses MultiWorkspace? | **Yes** — via `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` |

### Complements vs duplicates `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion`

- **Complements:** ALE adjusts chrome visibility and rail presets; PWR hosts thread/workbench/multi-pane chat. No layout ownership conflict if events stay on the bus.
- **Does not replace:** PWR is the structural shell; ALE is an operator tool modal.

### Props required to mount safely (minimal)

```text
open: boolean          // panels.isOpen('adaptive-layout') OR dedicated useState
onClose: () => void
onApplyLayout: (layout) => void   // must dispatch neuralshell:apply-layout + rail sync
```

Optional: wire open action from LayoutControlBar / slash / palette (May 2 had multiple `recordLayoutAction` dynamic imports).

### Risk if mounted without `handleAdaptiveLayout`

- UI would save presets to localStorage but **rail collapse / chrome toggles would not apply** consistently (hook reads storage, but May 2 also synced App rail state).

---

## 5. OperationsCoreLayer — deep dive

### Source

- **Exists:** `src/renderer/src/components/OperationsCoreLayer.jsx` (same lazy children as May 2)
- **Not imported** in current `App.jsx`

### May 2 mount

- Always rendered after `PaletteAndSettingsLayer`
- Props: `panels`, `runtimeCapabilityPayload`, large `ecosystemLauncherProps` / `missionControlProps` bags, fleet handlers
- Conditionally renders lazy children when `panels.isOpen('analytics'|'ecosystem'|'mission-control'|'fleet-control'|'recovery-center')`

### Current reachability

| Module | Without OCL | With P0/P1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mission / Ecosystem / Analytics | Eager direct JSX in App | Top bar chips + More + slash (unchanged behavior) |
| Fleet / Recovery | Eager direct JSX | More / slash |
| Task / Runtime alerts | Eager direct JSX | **Not in OCL** even in May 2 — always App-level lazy |

### Would OCL restore old Mission/Ecosystem style?

- **Functionally similar** if `showMissionControl` / `showEcosystem` were migrated to `panels.open('mission-control'|'ecosystem')` and OCL mounted.
- **Does not by itself restore chunking** unless App stops eager-importing those modules (OCL already lazy-imports them).

### Risk mounting OCL now (post P0/P1)

| Risk | Severity | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Duplicate Mission/Ecosystem instances | **High** if both OCL + eager `<MissionControl>` / `<EcosystemLauncher>` run | Must remove eager mounts first |
| Dual open state (`panels` vs `showMissionControl`) | **High** | Top bar chips use `setShowMissionControl(true)` today |
| Props drift | Medium | OCL expects large callback bags; May 2 had `openFromEcosystem*` helpers |
| Bundle win | Low until eager imports removed | OCL lazy only helps when App doesn't static-import same modules |

**Conclusion:** OCL is a **structural host**, not the first lever. Prefer **lazy imports + panel-id unification** before re-enabling OCL.

---

## 6. Bundle output implications

### If we only add `React.lazy` in `App.jsx` (no mount changes)

| Change | Expected new chunks (Vite default naming) |
| --- | --- |
| `lazy(() => import('./MissionControl'))` | `MissionControl-[hash].js` |
| `lazy(() => import('./EcosystemLauncher'))` | `EcosystemLauncher-[hash].js` |
| `lazy(() => import('./TaskManagerDrawer'))` | `TaskManagerDrawer-[hash].js` |
| `lazy(() => import('./RuntimeAlertsDrawer'))` | `RuntimeAlertsDrawer-[hash].js` |
| `lazy(() => import('./AdaptiveLayoutEngine'))` | `AdaptiveLayoutEngine-[hash].js` |
| Batch lazy for ~50 GTM consoles | ~50 additional async chunks (May-2-like tree) |

### If we mount `OperationsCoreLayer` (eager) without removing App eager imports

- **No bundle improvement** (duplicate module graph risk).
- Must **delete** static imports of Mission/Ecosystem/Fleet/Recovery/Analytics from App when switching to OCL.

### If we mount ALE only

- One new chunk when lazy-imported; main bundle shrinks by ALE + dependencies (~similar to May 2 `AdaptiveLayoutEngine-*.js`).
- Runtime behavior change **only** when user opens ALE and applies a layout (needs `handleAdaptiveLayout`).

### Can lazy boundaries restore May 2 shape without behavior change?

- **Yes for load-time / memory:** code-splitting only; same components, same props, wrap in `<Suspense>`.
- **No for open-state semantics** if migrating `showMissionControl` → `panels.open('mission-control')` — that is a separate, testable refactor.

PR #73 vite `manualChunks` already enables vendor splits; **feature chunks require `React.lazy` / dynamic `import()` in source**.

---

## 7. Smallest safe implementation slices (recommended sequence)

### Slice A — **P2 lazy boundaries (operator core)** ← safest first

**Scope:** `App.jsx` only (plus Suspense fallbacks).

Convert to `React.lazy` + conditional render (keep existing `show*` state):

- `MissionControl`, `EcosystemLauncher`, `TaskManagerDrawer`, `RuntimeAlertsDrawer`
- `CommandPalette`, `SettingsDrawer` (or switch to existing `PaletteAndSettingsLayer`)

**Do not:** mount OCL, mount ALE, change open handlers, remove P1 chips.

**Acceptance:** E2E mission/ecosystem/task tests pass; build emits separate chunks; main `index` size drops.

**Risk:** **Low**

---

### Slice B — **P2b AdaptiveLayoutEngine restore**

**Scope:** `App.jsx` + optional entry in `LayoutControlBar` or slash.

- `const AdaptiveLayoutEngine = React.lazy(...)`
- Restore `handleAdaptiveLayout` + `synchronizeAppLayoutFromAdaptiveEngine` (port from May 2 or minimal rail-only sync)
- `panels.open('adaptive-layout')` or dedicated `showAdaptiveLayout` state
- Mount with `onApplyLayout={handleAdaptiveLayout}`

**Do not:** mount OCL in same PR.

**Risk:** **Low–medium** (layout side effects; test rail presets)

---

### Slice C — **GTM console lazy batch**

**Scope:** `App.jsx` — lazy the remaining ~45 eager GTM imports (lines 26–73 today).

**Risk:** **Low** technically; **medium** CI time / chunk count

---

### Slice D — **OperationsCoreLayer + panel-id unification** (later)

**Scope:** Remove eager Mission/Ecosystem/Analytics/Fleet/Recovery JSX from App; mount OCL; map TopStatusBar / slash / tray to `panels.open(...)`.

**Prerequisite:** Slice A proves lazy path; decide single source of truth for open state.

**Risk:** **Medium–high** (duplicate overlay risk, large prop plumbing)

---

### Slice E — **Footer / proof parity** (defer)

Not lazy-boundary work; separate lane after ALE + chunk restore.

---

## 8. Answers to review questions

| # | Question | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Top missing lazy boundaries | **All `App.jsx` operator imports** (Mission, Ecosystem, Task, Alerts, CommandPalette, Settings, entire GTM console block); **AdaptiveLayoutEngine** not imported; **OperationsCoreLayer** unmounted |
| 2 | ALE before OCL? | **Yes.** ALE is isolated, complements PWR, no conflict with P1 chips. OCL requires deduping eager mounts and unifying panel state. |
| 3 | Is this implementation P2? | **Yes — Slice A/B are the correct P2** (lazy boundaries + ALE). Footer/proof is a different P2 label; call this **P2-lazy** or **P2a/P2b** to avoid confusion. |
| 4 | Safest first slice | **Slice A:** `React.lazy` Mission + Ecosystem + Task + RuntimeAlerts + Palette/Settings in `App.jsx`, keep `show*` handlers and P1 chips unchanged |
| 5 | Files likely involved | **Primary:** `App.jsx`. **Optional B:** `AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` (no change), `LayoutControlBar.jsx` (open entry). **Later D:** `OperationsCoreLayer.jsx`, `TopStatusBar.jsx`, `RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer.jsx` |
| 6 | Risk level | Slice A: **Low**. Slice B (ALE): **Low–medium**. Slice D (OCL): **Medium–high** |

## 1. May 2 mount map

```text

├── TopStatusBar(panels={panels}, ...)     // chips call panels.open(...)
├── PaletteAndSettingsLayer
├── OperationsCoreLayer                  // ALWAYS mounted
│   ├── AnalyticsDrawer          if panels.isOpen('analytics')
│   ├── EcosystemLauncher          if panels.isOpen('ecosystem')
│   ├── MissionControl             if panels.isOpen('mission-control')
│   ├── FleetControlPanel          if panels.isOpen('fleet-control')

├── ApplianceConsole + 30+ GTM panels    // panels.isOpen(...) in App (NOT in OCL)

├── TaskManagerDrawer              panels.isOpen('task-manager')    // App, not OCL
```

| `importLocalRuntimeNode` | IPC import handler |

```text
├── TopStatusBar → setShowMissionControl / setShowEcosystem / setShowTaskManager / openRuntimePanelById('adaptive-layout')
```

OCL has **no local state** and **no separate panel registry**. It only reads:

4. `fleet` + `importLocalRuntimeNode` for Fleet

**Dependency fan-in (if OCL were mounted):** all `openFromEcosystem*` / `close*` callbacks and role-gated opens currently duplicated or inlined in current `App.jsx` would need to be restored as May 2 `useCallback` wrappers around `panels.open` / `panels.close`.

| AdaptiveLayoutEngine | App | App `panels` | Not in OCL; **no dup** |
| Recovery workspace panels | N/A (May 2 inline App) | `RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer` | **No ID overlap** with OCL five |

| **OCL** | `analytics`, `ecosystem`, `mission-control`, `fleet-control`, `recovery-center` |

# P2-LAZY-B3 — Adaptive Layout Engine (ALE) Polish Plan

**Base:** `master` @ `9c34524eac0fb5b8427d889e321901eea7d7a9c8`  
**Repo:** `NeuralShell_release_master_proof`  
**Date:** 2026-05-20  
**Scope:** Plan only. No source edits, no package/version, no OCL work.

**Context:** B1 (lazy panel + `panels.open('adaptive-layout')`), B2 (Layout top-bar chip) are merged. OCL inventory recommends **B3 before OCL state-bus migration**.

---

## Executive summary

| Question | Answer |
|----------|--------|
| What does Layout chip open? | Right-side modal **Adaptive Layout Engine** (400px): tabs **presets** / **panels** / **insights** |
| Visually clear enough? | **Partially** — modal chrome is good; preset vs rail-bar relationship and recovery limitations are **not** obvious |
| Operator / Focus / Wide / Compact explained? | **No** — those names are **not** ALE presets; users see **Minimal, Operator, Writing, Coding, HUD/Cockpit** instead |
| Aligned with HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious? | **Partially** — mapping exists in `App.jsx` but **not shown in ALE UI** |
| Close/Escape obvious? | **Yes technically** (X, backdrop, Escape via `useModalAccessibility`); **not stated in UI** |
| Safe May 2 gap without OCL? | **No OCL dependency**; most May 2 ALE UI already present; main gap is **recovery wiring honesty**, not missing May 2 module |
| Smallest polish? | **Copy + chrome only** in `AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` — scope callout, rail-bar mapping badges, disable/label dead panel toggles, humanize preset chips |
| One file? | **Yes — primary `AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` only** |
| Safe before OCL migration? | **Yes** |

**Risk level:** **LOW** (copy/chrome; no `synchronizeAppLayoutFromAdaptiveEngine` / preset map changes).

---

## 1. What ALE shows today (Layout chip → open)

**Open path (B2):** TopStatusBar **Layout** → `openRuntimePanelById('adaptive-layout')` → `panels.open('adaptive-layout')` → lazy mount `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` (`App.jsx` ~3290).

**Also:** `/layout`, `/adaptive-layout`, `/layout-engine`; Escape closes via `panels.close('adaptive-layout')` (`App.jsx` ~1821).

**UI structure:**

| Tab | Content |
|-----|---------|
| **presets** | Intro line; optional “Recommended for you”; five clickable presets with name + description + **raw panel id chips** (`thread-rail`, …) |
| **panels** | Toggles for 11 panel definitions by category (nav/chat/status/visual); Save Layout / Reset |
| **insights** | Usage histogram; “How it works” + `recordLayoutAction` developer note |

**Header:** “Adaptive Layout Engine” / subtitle “Usage-learned panel arrangement”.

**On preset apply:** `onApplyLayout` → `handleAdaptiveLayout` → `synchronizeAppLayoutFromAdaptiveEngine` + kernel chat line + `neuralshell:apply-layout` event.

---

## 2. What actually works in recovery shell (wiring truth)

B3 polish must reflect **real behavior**, not May 2 full-shell promises.

### Presets → main window (works)

| ALE preset | `ADAPTIVE_LAYOUT_TO_RAIL_PRESET` | LayoutControlBar segment | Effect |
|------------|----------------------------------|---------------------------|--------|
| **Minimal** | `hud` | **HUD** | Narrow rails; Flows/Bench collapse from preset panels |
| **HUD / Cockpit** | `hud` | **HUD** | Same rail preset as Minimal |
| **Writing** | `compact` | **Dense** | Tighter rails |
| **Operator** | `wide` | **Spacious** | Wide rails |
| **Coding** | `wide` | **Spacious** | Wide rails |

Rail IDs in `LayoutControlBar.jsx`: `hud` → label **HUD**, `compact` → **Dense**, `balanced` → **Standard**, `wide` → **Spacious**.

**Not ALE presets:** viewport modes **Focused / Balanced / Expanded** (`layoutMode` in `App.jsx` from breakpoint) — separate from ALE drawer.

### Panels tab (partial)

| Panel ID | Recovery behavior |
|----------|-------------------|
| `thread-rail` | **Works** — `synchronizeAppLayoutFromAdaptiveEngine` toggles thread collapse |
| `workbench-rail` | **Works** — same for workbench |
| `smart-suggest` | **Works** — `MultiWorkspace` + `useAdaptiveLayoutChrome` |
| `chat-summary` | **Works** — same |
| `ambient-status`, `quick-reply`, `live-token-budget`, `prompt-template`, `custom-actions`, `streaming-bar`, `particle-bg` | **No-op / deferred** — stored in localStorage only; no consumer in recovery shell |

**Panels-only apply** (`_shellSync: 'panels-only'`) intentionally **does not** change rail widths — correct, but easy to miss without copy.

---

## 3. Answers to planning questions

### 1. What does ALE show when opened from the Layout chip?

Right-hand modal with three tabs (see §1). Default tab **presets**. User can apply a workflow preset; optional recommendation block if usage data exists.

### 2. Is the panel visually clear enough for users?

**Moderate.** Strengths: distinct modal, tabs, selected-state on preset, recommendation card. Weaknesses:

- Subtitle emphasizes “usage-learned” before “changes rails under the chat”
- Preset list shows **internal panel ids**, not operator language
- No link to **HUD / Dense / Standard / Spacious** bar directly above workspace
- **Panels** tab implies all toggles work; most do not in recovery

### 3. Does it explain Operator / Focus / Wide / Compact?

**No — and it should not invent those as preset names.**

| Name users might expect | What exists today |
|-------------------------|-------------------|
| **Operator** | ALE preset “Operator” (= spacious rails + all tools) — **not** the same as “operator console” chips |
| **Focus** | Viewport **Focused Layout** (narrow window) — **not in ALE** |
| **Wide** | Rail bar **Spacious** (`wide`) — related to Operator/Coding presets |
| **Compact** | Rail bar **Dense** (`compact`) — related to Writing preset |

B3 should add a **short mapping line** per preset: e.g. “Sets rail bar: **Spacious** (HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious)”.

### 4. Labels aligned with HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious?

**Logic aligned, UI not.** `App.jsx` maps presets to `hud` / `compact` / `wide`; LayoutControlBar labels differ from ALE preset names (**HUD/Cockpit** vs bar **HUD** is close; **Operator** vs **Spacious** is not obvious).

### 5. Is close/escape path obvious?

**Behavior:** `useModalAccessibility` — focus trap, Escape → `onClose` → `panels.close('adaptive-layout')`, backdrop click closes, X with `data-accessible-overlay-close`.

**UX gap:** No footer hint (“Esc to close” / “Click outside to dismiss”). Competes with other Escape handlers in `App.jsx` but ALE registers capture-phase listener while open.

### 6. Stale May 2 behavior missing (safe without OCL)?

May 2 `AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` is **substantively the same** as current (same presets, tabs, storage keys). Nothing critical to **restore** from May 2 for B3.

**Safe without OCL:**

- Copy/chrome alignment (this plan)
- Optional: humanize tab labels (`Presets`, `Panels`, `Insights`)

**Not B3 (layout logic / wider wiring):**

- Wire more `useAdaptiveLayoutChrome` consumers for deferred panel IDs
- Reintroduce May 2 **ambient-morph** panel (separate from ALE; was `panels.open('ambient-morph')` in May 2 `App.jsx`)
- TopStatusBar `panels` prop (OCL/bus migration lane)

### 7. Smallest polish without changing layout logic?

See §5 **Proposed B3 slice** — copy, badges, disabled states, chip cleanup only. **Do not** change `LAYOUT_PRESETS`, `ADAPTIVE_LAYOUT_TO_RAIL_PRESET`, or `synchronizeAppLayoutFromAdaptiveEngine`.

---

## 4. Current ALE UX gaps

| Gap | Severity | B3 address? |
|-----|----------|-------------|
| Preset ↔ rail bar (HUD/Dense/Spacious) not shown | High | Yes — badge per preset |
| Panels tab toggles mostly no-op in recovery | High | Yes — “Recovery shell” scope + disable or annotate non-wired IDs |
| Raw `thread-rail` chips on preset cards | Medium | Yes — replace with human summary or hide |
| Operator/Focus/Wide/Compact confusion | Medium | Yes — glossary blurb in presets tab |
| No “Esc / backdrop closes” hint | Low | Yes — footer |
| Subtitle over-emphasizes ML vs rails | Low | Yes — reword |
| Insights `recordLayoutAction` dev text | Low | Optional trim for operators |
| Tab ids lowercase `presets` / `panels` | Low | Optional capitalize |
| Kernel message uses rail id `wide` not “Spacious” | Low | **Out of scope** if one-file; optional `App.jsx` one-liner in B3.1 |

---

## 5. Proposed copy/chrome polish (B3 implementation slice)

### B3-0 — Scope (single file)

**File:** `src/renderer/src/components/AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` only.

### B3-1 — Presets tab

1. **Subtitle:** e.g. “Adjust side columns (Flows / Bench) and rail width — matches the bar below the top bar.”
2. **Scope callout** (indigo info box):
   - “Recovery shell: presets update **rail widths** and **Flows/Bench** visibility. Most items under **Panels** only apply to chat chrome (Smart Suggest, Chat Summary) until full shell returns.”
3. **Per-preset rail badge** (static map, no App import):

   ```text
   minimal, hud     → Rail bar: HUD
   writing          → Rail bar: Dense
   operator, coding → Rail bar: Spacious
   ```

4. **Preset card chips:** Remove raw ids; show 1-line human summary, e.g. “Flows on · Bench off · Spacious rails”.
5. **Mini glossary** (3 bullets): Viewport **Focused/Balanced/Expanded** (window size); bar **HUD/Dense/Standard/Spacious** (manual rail widths); ALE **presets** (one-click combo).

### B3-2 — Panels tab

1. Header note: “Changes save locally. Only toggles marked **live** affect this build.”
2. For each `PANEL_DEFINITIONS` entry, `recoveryLive: true|false`:
   - **live:** `thread-rail`, `workbench-rail`, `smart-suggest`, `chat-summary`
   - **not live:** all others — render toggle **disabled** + `title="Not wired in recovery shell yet"` OR hide non-live rows (prefer **disabled + label** for honesty without shrinking list).
3. Keep Save/Reset behavior unchanged (storage still valid for future shell).

### B3-3 — Insights tab

1. Soften developer line about `recordLayoutAction` → “Usage stats improve recommendations over time.”
2. Keep “How it works” rail sentence; add “Use **Layout** in the top bar or `/layout` to reopen.”

### B3-4 — Chrome / a11y

1. Footer: “Esc · click outside · ✕ to close”.
2. Optional: `aria-describedby` pointing at scope callout.

### Explicitly out of B3 scope

- `LayoutControlBar.jsx` changes (no “open ALE” button unless product asks later)
- `App.jsx` / `handleAdaptiveLayout` kernel copy (B3.1)
- New panel wiring (`useAdaptiveLayoutChrome` expansion)
- New presets or rail mapping changes
- E2e spec commit (separate test PR per prior lanes)
- OCL / panel-bus migration

---

## 6. Files likely changed

| File | B3? | Notes |
|------|-----|-------|
| `src/renderer/src/components/AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` | **Yes (only)** | All proposed polish |
| `src/renderer/src/App.jsx` | No | Mount/apply logic stays |
| `src/renderer/src/components/TopStatusBar.jsx` | No | B2 chip sufficient |
| `src/renderer/src/components/LayoutControlBar.jsx` | No | Reference in copy only |
| `src/renderer/src/hooks/useAdaptiveLayoutChrome.js` | No | B4+ wiring if ever |

---

## 7. Risk level

| Area | Level |
|------|-------|
| B3 copy/chrome only | **LOW** |
| B3 if panel wiring added | **MEDIUM** (scope creep) |
| OCL mount (deferred) | **HIGH** |

---

## 8. Acceptance checks (manual / smoke)

After B3 implementation (future PR):

1. Layout chip opens ALE; `data-testid="adaptive-layout-engine"` visible.
2. Each preset shows **Rail bar: HUD/Dense/Spacious** badge; applying **Operator** moves LayoutControlBar highlight to **Spacious** and widens rails.
3. Applying **Minimal** or **HUD** highlights **HUD** on bar.
4. **Panels** tab: toggling `smart-suggest` / `chat-summary` affects MultiWorkspace; toggling `quick-reply` shows disabled state and does not claim “live”.
5. Escape, backdrop, and X close panel; `panels.isOpen('adaptive-layout')` false.
6. `/layout` still opens panel; no regression to Mission/Eco/Tasks chips.
7. No new console errors; build/lint/test pass.
8. localStorage keys unchanged (`neuralshell_adaptive_layout_v1`, `neuralshell_layout_usage_v1`).

---

## 9. One-file vs multi-file?

**Recommendation: one-file `AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` for B3.**

Rationale:

- All gaps are presentation and honest scoping inside the drawer.
- `App.jsx` kernel message improvement is optional **B3.1** (1–2 lines) — not required for acceptance.
- `LayoutControlBar` cross-link is copy-only inside ALE.

---

## 10. Safe before OCL state migration?

**Yes.** B3 does not touch `usePanelManager` bus for Mission/Eco/Analytics/Fleet/Recovery, does not mount OCL, and does not change `openRuntimePanelById` except through existing adaptive-layout id.

**Sequence:**

1. **B3** — ALE polish (this plan)  
2. **OCL state-bus migration plan/PR** — unify `panels` vs `useState`  
3. **OCL restore** — mount layer after dedupe  

---

## 11. B3 vs OCL — ordering

| Lane | When |
|------|------|
| **B3 ALE polish** | Next implementation PR (small) |
| **OCL inventory** | Done |
| **OCL state-bus migration** | After B3; plan-only then implement |
| **OCL mount** | After migration only |

**B3 ALE polish should not wait for OCL.** OCL should wait for B3 and bus migration.

---

## 12. Reference snippets (current wiring)

**Mount (B1):** `App.jsx` — `panels.isOpen('adaptive-layout')` + lazy `AdaptiveLayoutEngine`.

**Rail sync:** `ADAPTIVE_LAYOUT_TO_RAIL_PRESET` in `App.jsx` (lines ~247–253).

**Layout chip (B2):** `TopStatusBar.jsx` — `data-testid="adaptive-layout-open-btn"`, title “Adaptive Layout Engine”.

**May 2 reference:** `validation-artifacts/ui-recovery/asar-full-release-232/src/renderer/src/components/AdaptiveLayoutEngine.jsx` — same preset set; May 2 also used `panels.open('adaptive-layout')` with lazy mount in `App.jsx`.

---

*Plan artifact only — not committed to git per operator instruction.*

## 2. Current panel bus map (PHASE 1)

Legend: **PM** = `usePanelManager` (`panels.open` / `panels.isOpen` / `panels.close`) · **SS** = `useState` `show*` in `App.jsx` · **SC** = `ShellContext` (`useShell`) · **RW** = `RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer` (PM IDs, not OCL).

### Summary table (requested surfaces)

| Surface | Panel ID (canonical) | Open bus | Close bus | Mount host today | OCL child? |
|---------|----------------------|----------|-----------|------------------|------------|
| Mission Control | `mission-control` | **SS** | **SS** + Esc | `App.jsx` lazy `MissionControl` (always in Suspense tree) | Yes |
| Ecosystem | `ecosystem` | **SS** | **SS** + Esc | `App.jsx` lazy `EcosystemLauncher` (always in Suspense tree) | Yes |
| Analytics | `analytics` | **SS** | inline `setShowAnalytics(false)` only | `App.jsx` sync `AnalyticsDrawer` (conditional mount) | Yes |
| Fleet Control | `fleet-control` | **SS** (+ role gate) | **SS** + Esc | `App.jsx` sync `FleetControlPanel` | Yes |
| Recovery Center | `recovery-center` | **SS** (+ role gate) | **SS** + Esc | `App.jsx` sync `RecoveryCenter` | Yes |
| Task Manager | `task-manager` | **SS** | **SS** + Esc | `App.jsx` lazy `TaskManagerDrawer` | No (May 2: App) |
| Runtime Alerts | `runtime-alerts` / `watchdog` | **SS** | **SS** + Esc | `App.jsx` lazy `RuntimeAlertsDrawer` | No (May 2: App) |
| Adaptive Layout | `adaptive-layout` | **PM** | **PM** + Esc | `App.jsx` lazy `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` | No |
| Command Palette | N/A (`showPalette`) | **SC** | **SC** + Esc | `App.jsx` `CommandPalette` | No |
| Settings | N/A (`showSettings`) | **SC** | **SC** + Esc | `App.jsx` `SettingsDrawer` | No |

### Open paths (detailed)

#### Mission Control (`mission-control`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar P1 chip `mission-control-open-btn` | `onOpenMissionControl` → `setShowMissionControl(true)` |
| TopStatusBar overflow “More” | Same callback |
| Slash `/mission` | `setShowMissionControl(true)` |
| `openRuntimePanelById('mission-control' \| 'mission')` | `setShowMissionControl(true)` |
| Ecosystem launcher `onOpenMissionControl` | `setShowEcosystem(false)` + `setShowMissionControl(true)` |
| Mission hydration / first-boot flows | `setShowMissionControl(true)` (several `useEffect` / handlers) |
| Tray | Not dedicated (palette/settings/tasks only) |

#### Ecosystem (`ecosystem`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar P1 chip `ecosystem-open-btn` | `setShowEcosystem(true)` |
| TopStatusBar overflow | Same |
| Slash `/ecosystem` | `setShowEcosystem(true)` |
| `openRuntimePanelById` | **No** `ecosystem` branch (not routed) |

#### Analytics (`analytics`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar overflow `analytics-open-btn` | `setShowAnalytics(true)` |
| Slash | **None** |
| `openRuntimePanelById` | **No** `analytics` branch |

#### Fleet Control (`fleet-control`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar overflow `fleet-control-open-btn` | `setShowFleetControl(true)` (no role check on bar) |
| Slash `/fleet` | `setShowFleetControl(true)` |
| `openRuntimePanelById('fleet-control' \| 'fleet')` | Role gate → `setShowFleetControl(true)` |
| Ecosystem / Mission cross-links | `setShow*(false)` + `setShowFleetControl(true)` or Mission `onOpenFleet` |

#### Recovery Center (`recovery-center`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar | **No** dedicated chip (slash / ecosystem / mission only) |
| Slash `/recovery` | `setShowRecoveryCenter(true)` |
| `openRuntimePanelById('recovery-center' \| 'recovery')` | Role gate → `setShowRecoveryCenter(true)` |
| Ecosystem / Mission cross-links | `setShowEcosystem(false)` + `setShowRecoveryCenter(true)` etc. |

#### Task Manager (`task-manager`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar P1 chip `task-manager-open-btn` | `setShowTaskManager(true)` |
| Overflow “Task Manager” | Same |
| Slash `/tasks` \| `/taskmanager` \| `/processes` | `setShowTaskManager(true)` |
| `openRuntimePanelById('task-manager' \| 'tasks')` | `setShowTaskManager(true)` |
| Tray `onTrayOpenTaskManager` | `setShowTaskManager(true)` |
| Hotkey Ctrl+Shift+T | Toggle `showTaskManager` |

#### Runtime Alerts (`runtime-alerts`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| `WatchdogStatusBadge` | `onOpenRuntimeAlerts` → `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` |
| `openRuntimePanelById('watchdog')` | `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` |
| Mission `onOpenWatchdog` | `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` |
| Slash `/watchdog` (if present in handler block) | via `openRuntimePanelById` pattern |

#### Adaptive Layout (`adaptive-layout`)

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar Layout chip | `openRuntimePanelById('adaptive-layout')` → `panels.open('adaptive-layout')` |
| Slash `/layout` \| `/adaptive-layout` \| `/layout-engine` | `panels.open('adaptive-layout')` |
| Close | `closeAdaptiveLayout` → `panels.close('adaptive-layout')`; Esc in key handler |

#### Command Palette

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar EXEC `command-palette-btn` | `openPalette()` (**SC**) |
| Ctrl+K | `togglePalette()` (**SC**) |
| `RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer` / placeholders | `onOpenPalette` → `openPalette` |
| Close | `closePalette()`; Esc |

#### Settings

| Path | Mechanism |
|------|-----------|
| TopStatusBar `settings-open-btn` | `handleOpenSettings` → `openSettings()` (**SC**) |
| Ctrl+, | `openSettings()` |
| Slash `/settings` | `openSettings()` via `openRuntimePanelById` |
| Mission `onOpenSettings` | `openSettings()` |
| Close | `closeSettings()`; Esc |

### `panels` usage today (non-OCL)

| Panel ID | Opened via PM | Host |
|----------|---------------|------|
| `adaptive-layout` | Top bar, slash | `App.jsx` lazy ALE |
| `projects-mode`, `agent-store`, `voice-mode`, `knowledge-base`, `multi-model-split`, `ai-memory` | `MultiWorkspace` toolbar | `RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer` |

**Single `usePanelManager()` instance** in `App.jsx` (line ~312) shared by recovery layer + ALE.

### `OperationsCoreLayer.jsx` (reference only — not mounted)

Expects **PM** IDs: `analytics`, `ecosystem`, `mission-control`, `fleet-control`, `recovery-center`.  
Children gated with `panels.isOpen(id)`; closes via `panels.close(...)` props.  
Internal lazy imports for all five children.

### Escape key behavior (gap)

Global Esc handler closes **SS** OCL-related flags and **PM** `adaptive-layout`, but **not** `showAnalytics`.  
After migration, Esc should call `panels.close('<id>')` for each OCL ID (and optionally `showAnalytics` until removed).

### Stacking behavior today (why migration matters)

`usePanelManager` is **modal** (one `activePanel`).  
Mission/Eco/Tasks/Fleet/Recovery/Analytics use **independent `useState`**, so **multiple full-screen modals can stack** (e.g. Mission + Ecosystem both `open={true}`).  
May 2 / OCL: opening one PM panel **replaces** the previous PM panel.

---

## 3. OCL overlap table

| OCL panel ID | `App.jsx` `show*` state | Direct mount in `App.jsx` | `openRuntimePanelById` | TopStatusBar | Slash |
|--------------|-------------------------|---------------------------|------------------------|--------------|-------|
| `analytics` | `showAnalytics` | `{showAnalytics && <AnalyticsDrawer/>}` | No | Overflow | No |
| `ecosystem` | `showEcosystem` | `<EcosystemLauncher open={showEcosystem}/>` (Suspense, always mounted) | No | P1 chip + overflow | `/ecosystem` |
| `mission-control` | `showMissionControl` | `<MissionControl open={showMissionControl}/>` (Suspense) | Yes | P1 chip + overflow | `/mission` |
| `fleet-control` | `showFleetControl` | `<FleetControlPanel open={showFleetControl}/>` | Yes (role) | Overflow | `/fleet` |
| `recovery-center` | `showRecoveryCenter` | `<RecoveryCenter open={showRecoveryCenter}/>` | Yes (role) | Indirect | `/recovery` |

**No ID overlap** between OCL five and `RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer` six.

**Not in OCL:** `task-manager`, `runtime-alerts`, `adaptive-layout`, GTM `show*` consoles (40+), `showPalette` / `showSettings`.

---

## 4. Duplicate-host risk table

| Risk | Condition | Severity | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|----------|------------|
| Double Mission/Eco UI | Mount OCL **and** keep `App.jsx` hosts with same `open` true | **Critical** | OCL-B **must** remove App hosts for the five; never mount OCL while `showMissionControl` etc. still drive parallel hosts |
| Double lazy chunk work | OCL + App both render `EcosystemLauncher` / `MissionControl` | **High** | Single host only; OCL already lazy-loads children |
| PM vs SS desync | Opens use `panels.open` but mount still uses `show*` | **High** | OCL-A: gate mounts on `panels.isOpen` and delete `show*` for that ID in same PR |
| Partial eco→mission nav | Eco on SS, mission on PM | **High** | Migrate **all five** OCL IDs in OCL-A before OCL-B; eco callbacks become `panels.open('mission-control')` only |
| Recovery panel displaced | Open Mission while Projects open | **Medium** (intended) | Document; extend smoke: open Projects → Mission → assert `recovery-panel-projects-mode` hidden |
| Analytics stuck open | Esc doesn’t close analytics today | **Low** | Fix in OCL-A: `panels.close('analytics')` on Esc |
| Tasks + Mission stack | Tasks stay SS after OCL-A | **Low** (pre-existing) | OCL-C optional; or accept until tasks on PM |
| GTM consoles | Still SS; Mission `onOpenAppliance` etc. | **None** for OCL mount | Out of scope; keep `openRuntimePanelById` / `setShow*` for GTM |

---

## 5. Design answers (PHASE 2)

### Q1. Which `App.jsx` `useState` hosts overlap OCL IDs?

Exactly these five: `showAnalytics`, `showEcosystem`, `showMissionControl`, `showFleetControl`, `showRecoveryCenter`.

### Q2. Which handlers should switch to `panels.open`?

All opens for the five IDs above, including:

- `TopStatusBar` `onOpenAnalytics` / `onOpenEcosystem` / `onOpenMissionControl` / `onOpenFleetControl`
- Slash `/ecosystem`, `/mission`, `/fleet`, `/recovery`
- `openRuntimePanelById` branches for `mission-control`, `fleet-control`, `recovery-center` (add `ecosystem`, `analytics`)
- Ecosystem → Mission/Fleet/Recovery callbacks (replace `setShowEcosystem(false); setShowMissionControl(true)` with `panels.open('mission-control')`)
- Mission `onOpenFleet` / `onOpenRecovery` → `panels.open(...)` with role checks preserved

### Q3. Which close handlers become `panels.close`?

- Component `onClose` props for the five → `() => panels.close('<id>')` or dedicated `useCallback`s (May 2: `closeAnalytics`, `closeFleetControl`, `closeRecoveryCenter`, ecosystem/mission `onClose` in prop bundles).
- Esc key branches for ecosystem, mission, fleet, recovery → `panels.close('<id>')`.
- Remove `setShow*` false branches when state is deleted.

### Q4. Which direct mounts must be removed before OCL mount?

Before **OCL-B**, App may still host components but **only** gated on `panels.isOpen` (OCL-A).  
Before **OCL-B merge**, **remove** from `App.jsx`:

- `{showAnalytics && <AnalyticsDrawer .../>}` block
- `<EcosystemLauncher open={showEcosystem} .../>` block (+ prop blob)
- `<MissionControl open={showMissionControl} .../>` block (+ prop blob)
- `<FleetControlPanel open={showFleetControl} .../>`
- `<RecoveryCenter open={showRecoveryCenter} .../>`

Replace with single `<OperationsCoreLayer ... />` (or lazy wrapper).

### Q5. One-by-one or together?

| Phase | Together? |
|-------|-----------|
| **OCL-A** (state bus only) | **All five OCL IDs in one PR** (or two PRs: Mission+Eco first, then Analytics+Fleet+Recovery). Do **not** leave Eco on SS while Mission on PM — cross-nav breaks. |
| **OCL-B** (mount OCL) | **Single PR** after OCL-A is green — OCL is one component hosting all five. |
| **OCL-C** (Tasks/Alerts) | **Independent** — can be one PR or deferred. |

### Q6. Tasks/Alerts — OCL or separate?

**Keep outside OCL** (matches May 2).  
**Recommended:** OCL-C optionally moves Tasks/Alerts to `panels.open('task-manager' \| 'runtime-alerts')` with hosts **remaining in `App.jsx`** (not inside OCL).  
Benefit: P1 chips participate in modal semantics with recovery/ALE panels.  
Not required for OCL-B.

### Q7. Tests proving no duplicate modal

| Check | Method |
|-------|--------|
| Single DOM host | `page.getByTestId('mission-control').count() === 1` after open |
| No double eco | `ecosystem-launcher` count === 1 |
| PM mutual exclusion | Open Mission → open Ecosystem → Mission test id **hidden** or `open={false}` |
| OCL-A regression | Re-run B2/B3 smoke + P1 chip smoke |
| OCL-B regression | Above + visual/Electron proof after App hosts removed |
| Recovery interaction | Projects open → Mission chip → projects panel closed |
| Build | `npm run build --prefix src/renderer`; existing tear tests |

Add tear unit test: mock `usePanelManager`, mount `OperationsCoreLayer` only with one `isOpen` true — assert one child type rendered (optional).

### Q8. Smallest implementation slice

**OCL-A0 (smallest):** `mission-control` only — still **blocked** until ecosystem `onOpenMissionControl` is updated in the same PR or eco migrates simultaneously.

**True smallest safe slice:** **OCL-A** — all five IDs → PM, App hosts gated on `panels.isOpen`, delete five `show*` states, **no** `OperationsCoreLayer` import.

**OCL-B:** Mount OCL + delete duplicate JSX (~300 lines of prop wiring moves into `ecosystemLauncherProps` / `missionControlProps` bundles).

### Q9. Lazy-import OCL when?

| When | Recommendation |
|------|----------------|
| OCL-A | **Do not** import OCL |
| OCL-B | **Lazy-import** `OperationsCoreLayer` in `App.jsx` (`React.lazy` + `Suspense`) — matches May 2 chunk strategy and avoids bloating main bundle until needed |
| OCL internals | Already lazy-import children inside OCL |

### Q10. Rollback path

1. **Revert OCL-B PR** — restores direct App mounts; keep OCL-A PM wiring or revert both.
2. **Feature flag** (optional): `USE_OPERATIONS_CORE_LAYER = false` → render legacy App hosts when false (short-term bridge only; avoid long dual-path).
3. **Proof artifacts** per slice under `validation-artifacts/post-release/phase-ocl-state-bus-migration/`.
4. Release: no tag required for migration PRs; v2.1.34 unaffected until explicit release.

---

## 6. Recommended migration sequence (PHASE 3)

### Slice OCL-A — Unify state bus (no OCL mount)

**Goal:** All opens/closes/esc/Esc for the five OCL IDs use `panels`; App.jsx still hosts components but **only** when `panels.isOpen(id)`.

**Tasks:**

1. Add helpers: `openOperationsPanel(id)`, `closeOperationsPanel(id)` wrapping role gates + `panels.open/close`.
2. Replace TopStatusBar callbacks, slash handlers, `openRuntimePanelById` branches for the five IDs.
3. Replace ecosystem/mission cross-navigation with `panels.open` (drop paired `setShowEcosystem(false)` where redundant).
4. Change mounts:
   - Analytics: `{panels.isOpen('analytics') && <AnalyticsDrawer onClose={() => panels.close('analytics')} />}`
   - Eco/Mission: conditional mount **or** keep `open={panels.isOpen(...)}` but ensure not duplicated later — prefer conditional mount to match OCL.
5. Update Esc handler + delete five `useState` booleans and dependency arrays.
6. Extend `openRuntimePanelById` with `ecosystem` and `analytics` → `panels.open`.

**Do not:** `import OperationsCoreLayer`.

**Proof:** Electron smoke (Mission/Eco/Tasks/Analytics overflow/Fleet/Recovery slash), assert `panels.activePanel` via optional debug hook or DOM exclusivity.

---

### Slice OCL-B — Mount OCL once

**Goal:** Single orchestration layer; remove duplicate App hosts.

**Tasks:**

1. `const OperationsCoreLayer = React.lazy(() => import('./components/OperationsCoreLayer.jsx'));`
2. Build `ecosystemLauncherProps` and `missionControlProps` (extract from current inline JSX — large but mechanical).
3. Render:

```jsx
<React.Suspense fallback={null}>
  <OperationsCoreLayer
    panels={panels}
    closeAnalytics={() => panels.close('analytics')}
    runtimeCapabilityPayload={runtimeCapabilityPayload}
    ecosystemLauncherProps={...}
    missionControlProps={...}
    fleet={fleet}
    importLocalRuntimeNode={importLocalRuntimeNode}
    closeFleetControl={() => panels.close('fleet-control')}
    closeRecoveryCenter={() => panels.close('recovery-center')}
  />
</React.Suspense>
```

4. **Delete** the five duplicate component blocks from `App.jsx`.
5. Verify GTM `onOpen*` from Mission/Ecosystem still target `openRuntimePanelById` / GTM `show*` (unchanged).

**Proof:** Same as OCL-A + `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=mission-control]').length === 1`.

---

### Slice OCL-C — Tasks/Alerts on PM (optional)

**Goal:** Align P1 Tasks chip and watchdog with modal bus; hosts stay in App.

- `onOpenTaskManager` → `panels.open('task-manager')`
- `onOpenRuntimeAlerts` → `panels.open('runtime-alerts')`
- Gate `TaskManagerDrawer` / `RuntimeAlertsDrawer` on `panels.isOpen`
- Remove `showTaskManager` / `showRuntimeAlerts` or sync Esc/hotkeys

**Defer** if stacking with Mission is acceptable short-term.

---

### Slice OCL-D — Cleanup

- Remove dead `show*` comments, shrink Esc handler if GTM migrated later
- Optional: `PaletteAndSettingsLayer` consolidation (separate from OCL)
- Remove feature flag if added

---

## 7. Smallest safe first implementation slice

**Ship first:** **OCL-A (full five IDs, no OCL mount).**

Rationale:

- Eliminates duplicate-modal stacking among operator consoles without touching OCL file.
- Unblocks OCL-B as a mechanical host swap.
- Lower blast radius than OCL-B; easy revert.

**Do not ship first:** OCL-B alone, or Mission-only without Eco cross-links.

---

## 8. Files likely changed

| `src/renderer/src/App.jsx` | Major | Major | Moderate |
| `src/renderer/src/components/OperationsCoreLayer.jsx` | — | — (no change if byte-identical) | — |
| `src/renderer/src/components/TopStatusBar.jsx` | — (callbacks from App only) | — | — |

| `src/renderer/src/components/RecoveryWorkspacePanelsLayer.jsx` | Unlikely | Unlikely | Unlikely |

---

## 9. Acceptance checks

### OCL-A

- [ ] `git status` clean; build + lint + test pass
- [ ] Mission/Eco/Tasks chips open/close (Tasks unchanged if OCL-C deferred)
- [ ] Overflow Analytics opens/closes; Esc closes analytics
- [ ] `/mission`, `/ecosystem`, `/fleet`, `/recovery` work
- [ ] Eco → Mission navigation closes eco UI
- [ ] Opening Mission closes an open `agent-store` recovery panel (modal semantics)
- [ ] No duplicate `data-testid="mission-control"` or `ecosystem-launcher`
- [ ] B3 ALE smoke still passes

### OCL-B

- [ ] All OCL-A checks
- [ ] `OperationsCoreLayer` mounted exactly once in tree
- [ ] No `showMissionControl` / `showEcosystem` / etc. in `App.jsx`
- [ ] Role gates for fleet/recovery preserved

### OCL-C (if done)

- [ ] Tasks + watchdog on PM; Ctrl+Shift+T still works
- [ ] Opening Tasks closes PM recovery panel when applicable

---

## 10. Risk level and implementation safety

| Work | Risk | Safe to implement now? |
|------|------|-------------------------|
| **This plan (read-only)** | None | **Yes** |
| **OCL-A** | **Medium** — wide `App.jsx` edit, UX change (modals no longer stack) | **Yes**, with smoke proof and single focused PR |
| **OCL-B** | **High** — prop extraction, large diff, lazy-load regressions | **Only after OCL-A merged and proven** |
| **OCL-C** | **Low–Medium** | Optional after OCL-B |
| **Mount OCL without OCL-A** | **Critical** | **No** |

**Overall:** Implementation of **OCL-A** is safe now subject to review + runtime smoke. **OCL-B is not safe** until OCL-A is on `master` and verified.

**Do not mount OCL** until OCL-A panel bus migration is complete.

# OCL-C: Tasks & Runtime Alerts — Panel Bus Migration Plan

**Phase:** OCL-C (plan only — no implementation)  
**Repo:** `NeuralShell_release_master_proof`  
**Base:** `master` @ `9c13f275181019a75a2287f6cf7a01b5bb4fe67c`  
**Date:** 2026-05-20  
**Status:** Read-only decision document

---

## Executive summary

OCL-B restored the May-style **OperationsCoreLayer** for five operator panels on the unified `usePanelManager` bus. **Tasks** and **Runtime Alerts** remain **App-owned** (`useState` booleans), mounted directly in `App.jsx`, outside `OperationsCoreLayer`.

**Recommended option: Option A — keep both App-owned for now.**

Rationale: Tasks/Alerts today **coexist** with OCL panels (stack on top via z-index). Moving them to `panels.open()` would adopt **replace semantics** (one active panel), changing operator workflow—especially **Mission Control → Watchdog**, which today opens alerts *without* closing Mission. The bus win (unified Escape) is real but smaller than the coexistence regression risk.

**If migration is pursued later:** Option **B** (Tasks only) is the smallest useful slice, following the existing **`adaptive-layout`** precedent (panel bus + App.jsx host, not OCL). Defer Runtime Alerts until pinned-overlay semantics are designed.

---

## 1. Current Tasks open/close map

| Trigger | Open path | Close path | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------------|-------|
| Top bar **Tasks** chip (`task-manager-open-btn`) | `onOpenTaskManager` → `setShowTaskManager(true)` | Drawer ✕ / backdrop → `setShowTaskManager(false)` | P1 chip in `TopStatusBar.jsx` |
| More menu → **Task Manager** | Same callback | Same | Duplicate testId as chip (`task-manager-open-btn`) |
| Slash `/tasks`, `/taskmanager`, `/processes` | `executeSignal` → `setShowTaskManager(true)` | Escape → `setShowTaskManager(false)` | Emits `runtime.panel.opened` `{ panel: 'task-manager' }` |
| `openRuntimePanelById('task-manager' \| 'tasks')` | `setShowTaskManager(true)` | — | NodeChain / runtime panel router |
| **Ctrl+Shift+T** | `setShowTaskManager(prev => !prev)` toggle | Same hotkey / Escape | Only Tasks has keyboard toggle |
| Tray menu **Open Task Manager** | `tray:open-task-manager` event → `setShowTaskManager(true)` | Drawer close / Escape | Wired in `main.js` → `preload.js` → `App.jsx` |
| Host render | `App.jsx` ~4016 | `open={showTaskManager}` gated lazy host | **Not** in `OperationsCoreLayer` |
| Z-index | Backdrop `z-[124]`, drawer `z-[125]` | — | Above Mission (`z-[121]`), below Recovery shell (`z-[128]`) |

**State:** `const [showTaskManager, setShowTaskManager] = React.useState(false)` (`App.jsx` ~507)

---

## 2. Current Runtime Alerts open/close map

| Trigger | Open path | Close path | Notes |
|---------|-----------|------------|-------|
| **Watchdog** badge (`watchdog-status-badge`) | `onOpenRuntimeAlerts` → `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` | Drawer ✕ / backdrop / Escape | Badge shows `watchdogStatus` + unack count; **does not auto-open** on new alerts |
| Mission Control → **Watchdog** button | `missionControlProps.onOpenWatchdog` → `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` | Same | **Stacks over open Mission** (z-125 > z-121) |
| Slash `/watchdog` | `executeSignal` → `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` | Escape | Event id `{ panel: 'watchdog' }` (not `runtime-alerts`) |
| `openRuntimePanelById('watchdog')` | `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)` | — | NodeChain `openPanel` handler |
| Host render | `App.jsx` ~3999 | `open={showRuntimeAlerts}` lazy host | **Not** in `OperationsCoreLayer` |
| Alert data | `watchdogAlerts` state from `RuntimeWatchdogSupervisor.evaluate()` | `acknowledgeWatchdogAlert` | Independent of drawer open state |
| Z-index | Same as Tasks: `z-[124]` / `z-[125]` | — | Coexistence overlay tier |

**State:** `const [showRuntimeAlerts, setShowRuntimeAlerts] = React.useState(false)` (`App.jsx` ~501)

**Not in More menu:** Runtime Alerts are reached via Watchdog badge only (Tasks is in More → tools).

---

## 3. May 2 / OCL architecture comparison

| Aspect | May-style OCL (restored in OCL-B) | Tasks / Runtime Alerts (current) |
|--------|-----------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| **OperationsCoreLayer hosts** | `analytics`, `ecosystem`, `mission-control`, `fleet-control`, `recovery-center` | **Excluded** — confirmed in `OperationsCoreLayer.jsx` |
| **Panel bus** | Five OCL panels use `panels.open()` / `panels.isOpen()` | App-owned `useState` booleans |
| **App.jsx hosts** | Single lazy `OperationsCoreLayer` mount | Direct `TaskManagerDrawer` + `RuntimeAlertsDrawer` hosts |
| **OCL-B scope** | Explicitly did **not** migrate Tasks/Alerts | Unchanged |
| **Precedent for non-OCL bus panels** | `adaptive-layout` on bus, hosted in App | Tasks/Alerts could mirror this pattern **without** joining OCL |

**Conclusion:** May 2 / inventory intent keeps Tasks and Runtime Alerts **outside OperationsCoreLayer**. OCL-C is about **panel manager bus**, not OCL mount. Do **not** add Tasks/Alerts to `OperationsCoreLayer.jsx`.

---

## 4. Conflict / coexistence table

| Scenario | Current (App-owned) | If on panel bus (replace) | If on panel bus (pinned alerts) |
|----------|--------------------|---------------------------|--------------------------------|
| Mission open → click **Tasks** chip | Both visible; Tasks on top | Mission **closes**; Tasks opens | Same as replace unless Tasks pinned |
| Mission open → **Watchdog** in Mission | Both visible; Alerts on top | Mission **closes**; Alerts opens | **Pinned `runtime-alerts`** keeps Mission + Alerts |
| Eco open → `/tasks` | Both visible | Eco **closes** | Depends on pin design |
| Tasks open → `/mission` | Both visible | Tasks **closes**; Mission opens | Consistent with OCL-A chip behavior |
| Tasks + Alerts both open | **Possible** (two booleans) | **Impossible** (one `activePanel`) | Alerts pinned could coexist with Tasks |
| Escape once | Closes OCL first block, then Tasks/Alerts in later block | Single `panels.close(activePanel)` path possible | Must unpin + close |
| P0 Recovery panel open → Tasks | Recovery z-128; Tasks z-125 **under** recovery | `panels.open('task-manager')` **closes** recovery panel | Regression for P0 unless recovery re-opened |
| Watchdog badge count | Unaffected by drawer open state | Unaffected | Unaffected |
| Ctrl+Shift+T toggle | Works on boolean | Needs `panels.toggle('task-manager')` | Same |

**Key insight:** OCL-A intentionally made top-bar **Mission/Eco** replace each other. **Tasks** is also a P1 top-bar chip but today behaves as a **utility overlay**, not a bus modal. **Runtime Alerts** is explicitly an overlay from Mission Watchdog.

---

## 5. Question-by-question answers

### 1. How are Tasks opened today?
Top bar chip, More menu, slash commands, `openRuntimePanelById`, Ctrl+Shift+T toggle, system tray event. All funnel to `setShowTaskManager(true)`.

### 2. How are Runtime Alerts opened today?
Watchdog badge, Mission Control Watchdog button, slash `/watchdog`, `openRuntimePanelById('watchdog')`. All funnel to `setShowRuntimeAlerts(true)`.

### 3. Coexist or replace OCL panels?
**Coexist today.** Separate state allows stacking over OCL modals (z-125 over z-121). Panel bus default is **replace** (see `p0-panel-manager-proof.js`).

### 4. Does May 2 keep Tasks/Alerts outside OperationsCoreLayer?
**Yes.** Current `OperationsCoreLayer.jsx` matches that boundary. OCL-B preserved it.

### 5. Would `panels.open` improve Escape/close consistency?
**Partially.** Escape already closes Tasks/Alerts in a later block (~1834–1844) after OCL panels (~1678–1691). Bus migration would unify close paths and enable `openRuntimePanelById` routing consistency for `task-manager` / `watchdog`. Benefit is **moderate**; not blocking.

### 6. Would migration break Watchdog badge behavior?
**Badge display: No** — `watchdogAlerts`, `watchdogStatus`, and `unacknowledgedWatchdogAlerts` are independent of open state.  
**Badge open interaction: Only if replace semantics close Mission** when opening from Mission Watchdog — that is a **UX behavior change**, not a badge bug.

### 7. Would migration break More menu behavior?
**No** if callbacks remain functionally equivalent (`onOpenTaskManager` → `panels.open('task-manager')`). Duplicate `task-manager-open-btn` testIds unchanged. Runtime Alerts not in More menu today.

### 8. Migrate together or separately?
**Separately.** Tasks aligns with top-bar chip / `adaptive-layout` precedent. Alerts has distinct overlay semantics from Mission — higher risk.

### 9. Panel IDs
| Surface | Recommended ID | Existing aliases |
|---------|----------------|------------------|
| Task Manager | **`task-manager`** | `tasks` in `openRuntimePanelById` |
| Runtime Alerts | **`runtime-alerts`** | Keep **`watchdog`** alias in router + slash events for backward compat |

Do **not** reuse ambiguous `tasks` as primary ID in UI events (already used as alias only).

### 10. Smallest safe implementation slice
**Option B — Tasks only**, mirroring `adaptive-layout`:
1. Remove `showTaskManager` state
2. Route all open paths → `panels.open('task-manager')` / `panels.toggle` for Ctrl+Shift+T
3. Gate host: `{panels.isOpen('task-manager') && <TaskManagerDrawer ... />}`
4. Escape: `panels.close('task-manager')`
5. **Do not** touch `OperationsCoreLayer.jsx`
6. Accept that Tasks replaces any open OCL panel (document + smoke Mission→Tasks)

**Do not** bundle Alerts in the same PR without pinned design.

---

## 6. Options classification

### Option A — Keep Tasks/Alerts App-owned ✅ **Recommended now**

| | |
|--|--|
| **Risk** | **Low** |
| **Pros** | Preserves overlay/coexistence; zero regression surface; matches OCL-B boundary; no Escape/router churn |
| **Cons** | Dual state model (bus + booleans); Escape handler stays split; `openRuntimePanelById` stays bifurcated |
| **When** | Default until product explicitly accepts replace semantics for Tasks and/or pinned overlay for Alerts |

### Option B — Move Tasks only to panel manager

| | |
|--|--|
| **Risk** | **Medium-low** |
| **Pros** | P1 Tasks chip aligns with Mission/Eco/Layout bus; cleaner router; single Escape path for Tasks |
| **Cons** | Tasks no longer stacks over OCL; Ctrl+Shift+T → toggle needs bus wiring; tray event must use `panels.open` |
| **Pattern** | Same as `adaptive-layout` (bus + App host, not OCL) |

### Option C — Move Runtime Alerts only

| | |
|--|--|
| **Risk** | **Medium** |
| **Pros** | `/watchdog` and badge use same bus as other runtime panels |
| **Cons** | Mission→Watchdog overlay lost unless `pinned` implemented; ID split (`watchdog` vs `runtime-alerts`) |
| **Prerequisite** | Design pinned overlay OR accept Mission closes on Watchdog open |

### Option D — Move both in one PR

| | |
|--|--|
| **Risk** | **Medium-high** |
| **Pros** | Fully unified bus for all right-rail operator drawers |
| **Cons** | Combines B + C risks; harder to bisect; e2e + smoke matrix doubles |
| **Not recommended** | Split B then C (with pin design) if ever pursued |

---

## 7. Recommended option

**Option A — defer migration.**

OCL-B closed the architectural gap (OCL mount + duplicate host removal). Tasks/Alerts are **smaller surfaces** but touch **workflow/status overlay behavior**. The inventory did not block release on bus-unifying these two.

**Future lane (optional):** OCL-C1 = Option B (Tasks only) after explicit sign-off that Tasks chip should **replace** open OCL panels like Layout chip does.

**Runtime Alerts:** stay App-owned until pinned-overlay semantics are specified.

---

## 8. Smallest safe implementation slice (if proceeding)

**OCL-C1: Tasks-only bus migration (Option B)**

```
Scope: App.jsx only (+ smoke/e2e if needed)
NOT in scope: OperationsCoreLayer, RuntimeAlertsDrawer, TopStatusBar structure
```

Steps:
1. Delete `showTaskManager` / `setShowTaskManager`
2. Add `closeTaskManager = () => panels.close('task-manager')`
3. Replace 6 open call sites (TopStatusBar prop, slash, openRuntimePanelById, tray, Ctrl+Shift+T)
4. Host: `{panels.isOpen('task-manager') && <TaskManagerDrawer open onClose={closeTaskManager} ... />}`
5. Escape: add `panels.close('task-manager')` in OCL block; remove boolean branch
6. Smoke: Mission open → Tasks chip → Mission hidden; Escape closes Tasks; tray + Ctrl+Shift+T

Estimated diff: ~40–60 lines in `App.jsx`.

---

## 9. Files likely changed (by option)

| File | Option A | Option B | Option C | Option D |
|------|----------|----------|----------|----------|
| `src/renderer/src/App.jsx` | — | **Yes** | **Yes** | **Yes** |
| `src/renderer/src/components/TaskManagerDrawer.jsx` | — | Unlikely | — | Unlikely |
| `src/renderer/src/components/RuntimeAlertsDrawer.jsx` | — | — | Unlikely | Unlikely |
| `src/renderer/src/components/TopStatusBar.jsx` | — | No* | No* | No* |
| `src/renderer/src/components/OperationsCoreLayer.jsx` | — | **No** | **No** | **No** |
| `src/renderer/src/hooks/usePanelManager.ts` | — | Only if pin needed | **Maybe** (pin API) | **Maybe** |
| `e2e/watchdogAlerts.spec.js` | — | — | Maybe | Maybe |
| `tear/p0-panel-manager-proof.js` | — | Optional new cases | Optional | Optional |

\*TopStatusBar unchanged if App passes `() => panels.open('task-manager')` instead of `setShowTaskManager(true)`.

---

## 10. Acceptance checks (if implementing Option B)

1. Tasks chip opens Task Manager via `panels.isOpen('task-manager')`
2. More menu Task Manager opens same panel
3. `/tasks` opens and emits `runtime.panel.opened` `{ panel: 'task-manager' }`
4. Ctrl+Shift+T toggles Tasks on panel bus
5. Tray **Open Task Manager** opens Tasks
6. Escape closes Tasks when active
7. Opening Tasks while Mission open **closes Mission** (documented replace semantics)
8. OCL panels (Eco, Analytics, Fleet, Recovery) unchanged
9. Runtime Alerts still App-owned; Watchdog badge still opens alerts overlay
10. P0 Projects/Agents/Voice unchanged
11. `OperationsCoreLayer` unchanged
12. Build/lint/test + Electron smoke pass

---

## 11. Risk level

| Option | Risk | Ready to implement? |
|--------|------|---------------------|
| **A (recommended)** | **Low** | N/A — no work |
| B (Tasks only) | Medium-low | **After product sign-off** on replace semantics |
| C (Alerts only) | Medium | **Not ready** — needs pinned/overlay design |
| D (both) | Medium-high | **Not ready** |

---

## 12. Is implementation safe now?

**No — intentionally paused.**

Safe to implement **Option B** only when:
- Stakeholders accept Tasks replacing (not stacking over) OCL panels
- Smoke matrix includes Mission→Tasks and P0 panel interactions
- Runtime Alerts remain App-owned in the same release

**Do not implement Option C/D** without resolving Mission→Watchdog coexistence (pinned set or explicit UX change).

---

## 13. Source edits in this phase

**None.** This document is read-only planning output.

---

## Appendix: Escape handler order (current)

`App.jsx` keydown ~1675–1858:

1. Palette, Settings
2. **OCL bus:** analytics, ecosystem, mission-control, fleet-control, recovery-center
3. GTM / runtime modals (appliance, airgap, … mission-scheduler, nodechain)
4. **App booleans:** `showRuntimeAlerts`, first-boot, split, **`showTaskManager`**
5. **Bus:** adaptive-layout
6. Session dialog, rail overlays

Tasks/Alerts are already in Escape; they are just not on the same state mechanism as OCL panels.

---

## Appendix: Related test coverage

- `e2e/watchdogAlerts.spec.js` — badge → drawer (App-owned path)
- OCL-B smoke — Mission/Eco/Fleet/Recovery via OCL; did not cover Tasks/Alerts bus
- `tear/p0-panel-manager-proof.js` — documents replace semantics

---

*End of OCL-C plan.*
